title: Ulpana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Eruvin 67a has Rav Nachman bar Ami reporting Ulpana; Hyman inserts that the first name should be Rav Chanin, as in Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin. Rashi explains that he heard it from his teacher, whereas Yuchasin takes Ulpana as a sage’s name. Dikdukei Soferim reads Ilfa. Arakhin 28b has Rabbi Chiya bar Abba reporting Chulfana; Hyman suggests the reading Ulpana.

notes.text: The supplied בא אמי is read with Eruvin 67a בר אמי, bar Ami, rather than Ami came. Rashi’s teacher-term explanation and Yuchasin’s personal-name explanation remain alternatives. The proposed Chanin and Ilfa readings belong to Hyman’s cited witnesses.

The consulted Eruvin 67a reads Nachman bar Ami; Rashi explains a teaching heard from his teacher, whose teacher heard it from his teacher. The exact Yuchasin and Dikdukei Soferim variants remain Hyman’s reports here.
